FOR VEHICLE OWNERS

Everything your vehicle needs, in one place.

From the day you add it to the day you sell it.

Track Everything

Add Your Vehicle

Registration, make, model and mileage — with a guided setup if you already have history.

Log Fuel Fill-ups

Odometer, litres and cost each time you fill up — the habit everything else depends on.

Add a Service Record

What was done, cost, mileage, brand and a photo of the receipt if you like.

Track Expenses

Insurance, licence, fines, parking, tolls — categorised so you see where money goes.

Know What's Coming

Predictions

"Oil due in 500 km" — worked out from your mileage and history, with the reason shown.

Cost Forecast

A realistic estimate of what the next few months are likely to cost.

Vehicle Tests & Renewals

Emission tests, wheel alignment, chain service, insurance and licence — all reminded in time.

Knowledge Hub

What your make and model actually needs, compared against what you're using.

Share, Book & Sell

Share With a Garage

Send only the records you choose before a service — nothing personal, nothing automatic.

Book a Garage Appointment

Pick a garage, a date and a slot — confirmed or rescheduled right in the app.

Sell / Transfer a Vehicle

The full verified history moves to the buyer the moment they accept — real proof, not a claim.

Family / Shared Access

Give a family member view-only access to a vehicle you both drive.

See Everything

History & PDF Export

A searchable timeline of every record, exportable as a PDF anytime you need it.

Analytics

Spend by category, cost per km, fuel trend, and a quick "trip ready" check.

Notifications

Reminded when something's due, a booking updates, or a garage submits work for review.

FOR GARAGES & SERVICE CENTERS

Run your bookings and your business, together.

From the first booking to your monthly revenue.

Run Your Day

Register Your Garage

Add your BR number for a verified badge — not required, but builds trust with owners.

Set Your Schedule

Open days, daily capacity, time slots — with overrides for holidays or busy days.

Manage Bookings

Confirm, reschedule, message the customer, or cancel — all from one list.

Calendar View

See how booked each day is at a glance, month by month.

Do the Work

Submit Completed Work

Parts, brands and cost — sent for the owner's approval and saved to their history.

Log a Walk-in Customer

Record completed work for a customer who didn't book through the app.

Grow Your Business

Customers

Every vehicle you've served, job count, revenue, and who's due for a reminder.

Revenue & Insights

Monthly revenue, average job value, repeat customers, and your top-earning services.

Customer Ledger

The paper service book your garage already keeps — kept for you automatically.

Ratings & Reviews

Customers rate completed jobs, building your reputation over time.

BUILT ON TRUST

A few things worth knowing.

Nothing shared without your say-so

Sharing with a garage, family member or buyer is always something you actively choose.

Personal expenses stay personal

Fines, parking and tolls are never shown to anyone but you — even though they're still yours.

Guidance, not orders

Every prediction shows where it came from — your history or the manufacturer — so you can judge it yourself.

VOCKSY Made for Sri Lankan vehicle owners and garages.
